chapter.p: UTF-16 code points from 2-byte sequence reader. The sequence is accessed using the special reader of the following structure:

synopsis.p: Tries to read the next code unit. Returns the code unit read on success, utf16::status::eof if no more code units are available or utf16::status::truncated_code_unit if only partial code unit is available.
Returns reference to the used code unit reader.

synopsis.prototype: template<class... Args> explicit reader(Args&&... args) C++11
synopsis.p: Forwards all parameters to the used code unit reader.

Tries to extract the next code point from code unit sequence using CodeUnitReader. On success the code point read is returned. utf16::status::eof is returned when no more code units available. Other values are returned on errors, see for more details. CodeUnitReader::operator() is used to access code units.
synopsis.note: The function itself does not throw exceptions, but exception can be thrown by CodeUnitReader::operator().

synopsis.p: The same as parse(), but returns sread_result on success or on EOF. Throws an exception from otherwise.
Creates UTF-16 reader using the specified CodeUnitReader.
